name: Namaiki Jisshuusei wa Yokkyuu Fuman ? ~ Kareshi Mochi no Shojo o Netoru Hanashi ~
original_name: ナマイキ実習生は欲求不満？ ～カレシ持ちの処女を寝取る話～
source:
Kimikazu Nunoda was hospitalized for the first time in his life with a broken bone.

His friends came to visit him, but not every day.
Even his family did not stay overnight at the hospital.
Most of the time, he had to stay in his hospital room in a daze.

One day, the nurse in charge changed.

She said, “My name is Kanon Suzuri, and I will be in charge of you from today. I look forward to working with you.
translation:
Kimikazu Nunoda生平第一次因骨折住进医院。

朋友们会来探望他，却不是每天都来。
就连家人也没有在医院过夜。
大多数时候，他只能茫然地待在病房里。

一天，负责照料他的护士换了人。

她说：“我叫Kanon Suzuri，从今天起由我负责照顾你。请多关照。”
